__comment: Replaces vanilla's minecraft:dye tint so a bench-dyed armour's ICON matches the one on the horse. Vanilla's source reads dyed_color, which a bench-dyed piece does not carry, so without this an armour that renders in three colours would sit in the hotbar looking plain - the same bug the saddle had on 2026-09-16, reported as 'it isn't storing the dye' when it always was. TackTintSource falls back to dyed_color for this item, so the vanilla crafting-grid recipe still colours the icon correctly. The icon shows the BLANKET, being the largest area; trim and fittings are in the tooltip.
